Name: Miss Coriel's Position Tool
Author: MissCoriel
Description:
[b]This is a modder's tool.  It has no use for people with no intention to mod Stardew Valley.
[/b]That being said.. This tool adds 2 commands to the console.  
[b]addhere: [/b]This command gets the map name and the X, Y coordinates from where your farmer is standing.  It will save it in a list.
[b]saveas:[/b] This command requires a parameter ([i]saveas <filename>[/i]) using this will save the list of coordinates you have onto a text file in [b]Stardew Valley/Coordinates/<filename>.txt

[/b]This update is a major update due to it's added use:
[list]
[*][b]NPC Creator Integration:[/b] you can use the config.json in the mod to point the Position Tool to your NPC Creator Folder and It will send the coordinates there.
[*][b]Three new commands:[/b] You can now use [b]startmove[/b] to set your current standing area as the starting point of a movement.  Walk to your next spot and use [b]finishmove <npc>[/b] and it will generate a useable movement command for events ([i]example: finishmove Haley will cause it to generate [/i][b]move Haley X Y F[/b]).  You can then use [b]savemove <filename>[/b] to save the movements you make into a text file and sent to a [b]Movements[/b] folder in either the SDV folder or the NPC Creator (There is nothing implemented yet to use these in NPC Creator).
[/list][size=5]Visit my [/size][url=https://discord.gg/uSGNKNf][size=5]Cozy Apartment[/size][/url][size=5] if you have questions or interests.[/size]
